title: Lane-Hook Reaver
text: Lane-Hook Reaver anchors a hooked chain into the route and pulls travelers out of formation. On loss, suffer 1 Wound.
flavor: Every road is a boarding plank if the hook holds.

defeatReward.text: Lane-Hook Reaver is defeated and its identifying marks are entered into your Trophy Pile.
